text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: These roaring cheers... The me who used to watch on TV while munching on mandarins under the kotatsu is no more.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's the Arima Kinen, Trainer!
The culmination of everything we've worked for so far!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I thought as long as luck was on my side,
I could make it this far. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have made it here on luck alone!
So many wonderful connections guided me here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My Trainer, who raised me with all their heart, and all the fans who cheered me on as if seeing themselves in me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Plus Suzuka-san, my fellow classmates,
my late older sister, and so many more!

Stepping outside, Matikanefukukitaru—
resolutely looks up at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All the light has gathered, bringing me to where I am now.
Today, I will not pray to the gods. Today—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I will become a deity—I'll become Lady Shiraoki!
A lucky girl who brings happiness to everyone!"
